Creation tools return to Select after a valid placement; unfinished paths remain active. V or Escape returns to Select. Typing in a field does not activate tools.

Stairs +: drag a footprint on the current floor, choose destinations, then confirm. Select a room to Convert to stairs, or select stairs to Edit connected floors.

Point editing: use the cyan outer frame’s square handles to resize. Shift locks proportions, Alt resizes from the center, and Ctrl bypasses the grid. Each finished point transform is one undoable edit.

3D mode: left click selects; left drag box-selects touched objects. Alt-left orbits, Alt-middle pans, Alt-right drag horizontally zooms (right in, left out). F frames selection. Tab switches 2D / 3D. Click a floor to focus. Escape returns to overview; ↑ / ↓ steps between focused floors. Isolate a floor to edit rooms.
